LOAN AGREEMENT
Borrower: HANGS Construction Services LLC · Loan agreement dated March 31, 2025, as amended March 31, 2026 · Sections 1.1, 2 and 6 excerpt
1.1 Definitions (excerpt)
“Capital Expenditures” means expenditures for fixed assets in a fiscal year at their full cost, however paid for or financed,
including assets acquired under finance leases.
“GAAP” means accounting principles generally accepted in the United States, applied consistently.
The financial covenants, their definitions and the compliance certificate are in Section 7.
2. The Facilities
2.1 Revolving Line. Up to $4,000,000.00, at the prime rate plus 0.50%, interest monthly in arrears on actual days over 360; all
advances due at maturity on March 31, 2027. The First Amendment of March 31, 2026 raised the Revolving Line to
$4,000,000.00 and extended its maturity to March 31, 2027.
2.2 Equipment Term Loan. $3,900,000.00 advanced March 31, 2025 at 7.10% fixed. Principal of $60,000.00 on the first day of
each month from May 1, 2025, with the month’s interest; all remaining principal due at maturity on March 31, 2030.
2.3 Security. Both facilities are secured by the Borrower’s equipment and receivables.
2.4 Mandatory prepayment. The net proceeds of any sale of equipment that secures the loans shall be paid to the Bank and
applied to the Equipment Term Loan, against the payment due at maturity. The scheduled monthly payments do not change.
6. Reporting and Other Covenants (excerpt)
6.1 Reporting. (a) Quarterly: within 45 days after each fiscal quarter end, the Borrower’s balance sheet and income statement
with a compliance certificate in the form of Exhibit C, signed by its controller. (b) Annual: within 120 days after each fiscal year
end (June 30), its annual financial statements prepared under GAAP and reviewed or audited by an independent certified public
accountant.
6.5 Capital Expenditures. The Borrower shall not make Capital Expenditures of more than $1,500,000.00 in any fiscal year
without the Bank’s written consent.
6.6 Notice. The Borrower shall notify the Bank promptly of any sale of equipment that secures the loans.
Executed for the Bank by Imani Calder, Vice President, Commercial Lending, and for the Borrower by Dana Whitfield, Controller.
